title: Tenma Saki — Old Piano Trio〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see... “I always have toast for breakfast, but today...”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hm? What's this word...?
O-ni-gi... Oh, onigiri!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “I always have toast for breakfast, but today, I'm having rice balls!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, onto the next paragraph...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: I'm back!!
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Tsukasa!
I've been waiting for you to get back!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? For me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, were you waiting so that we could have dinner together?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, Mom, Dad and I went ahead and ate after you said that we didn't need to wait for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, right...
I did say that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I decided to hold off on the jelly, because I do want to have dessert with you♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Saki...!
That's so thoughtful!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Wait, no. That's not what I want to tell you about!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I ran into Toya♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see.
He's helping out with Shibuya Instrument Day...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Speaking of which, weren't you and Mom talking about going to that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, but she has to hold an emergency practice session for her students because they have a competition coming up really soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I don't think we're gonna be able to go this year...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. I suppose her hands are tied with that competition coming up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But there are plenty of other events like it, so we made a deal to go to one of those if we can♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's good! I hope you both have a good time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Come to think of it, didn't we go to a similar event when we were little?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The one with all those orchestral instruments?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Weren't we given tickets to go because Toya's dad was going to perform in the concert? Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, but neither he nor his wife were able to join us since they had to prepare for that concert. Fortunately, we got to spend a lot of time with Toya.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ I remember that being really fun...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
Remember how the three of us played that piano together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I remember.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But we couldn't all fit onto the chair they had there, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! That's why you had me sit on your lap!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
As a result, I couldn't see the keys at all!
I had to ask Toya where C was since I had so much trouble finding it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, he said, “Further right!”
But when you went too far, he shouted, “No, that's A! Go back!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I remember that moment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, didn't a lot happen after we began to play?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I recall you pressing the C key, and my thumb on top of it too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That happened because you tried to play the part that I was gonna!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, really!
You said you'd let me play half of what the right hand's supposed to.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we had trouble dividing up everything, since we weren't very good at playing the piano back then.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, despite our chaotic performance, Toya seemed happy to go along with our antics.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I remember him always being so quiet whenever he was by himself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I get that he's always been the polite and earnest type...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I know he had it pretty rough sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Fortunately, he smiled and laughed whenever he was with us. That always made me happy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Same here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now I feel like talking to Toya.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We haven't had many chances to talk at school lately, so I might see if he'd like to have lunch sometime.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, no fair! That means you get to hog him!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know! I wanna hear more about how Shibuya Instrument Day went from him, so the three of us should go out for food sometime!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, excellent idea!
In that case, we'll need to ask Toya when he'll be free to go!
